name: GIGABYTE MZ71-CE1 2P

specs.Memory slots: 16 × DDR4 (8 channels per CPU), RDIMM/LRDIMM up to 3200 MHz, up to 128 GB per module

en.shortDescription: Dual-socket SP3 server board: 2 × EPYC, 16 DIMM slots, 5 SlimSAS ports and built-in IPMI management.
en.description: The GIGABYTE MZ71-CE1 runs two AMD EPYC processors for up to 128 cores on one board. 16 DDR4 slots (8 channels per CPU), up to five PCIe x16 slots, five SlimSAS connectors for SATA or NVMe drives and an ASPEED AST2500 BMC with a dedicated management port make it a proven foundation for render farms, virtualization clusters and storage servers.
en.name: GIGABYTE MZ71-CE1 2P

specs.Memory slots: 16 × DDR4 (8 channels per CPU), RDIMM/LRDIMM up to 3200 MHz, up to 128 GB per module
specs.Expansion slots: Up to 5 × PCIe x16 (Gen3; one slot runs Gen4 with EPYC 7002)
specs.SATA / SAS connectors: 4 × SATA 6Gb/s + 5 × SlimSAS (up to 12 × SATA and 5 × NVMe Gen3 x4)
specs.Rear I/O: 2 × USB 3.0, 1 × VGA, 1 × COM, 2 × RJ45, 1 × MLAN, ID button
specs.Remote management (BMC): ASPEED AST2500, GIGABYTE Management Console (AMI MegaRAC SP-X)
specs.TPM: TPM header (SPI), optional TPM 2.0 kit CTM010
specs.OS compatibility: Windows Server 2016/2019, RHEL 8.3+, SLES 12 SP5 / 15 SP2+, Ubuntu 18.04.5 / 20.04+, VMware ESXi 6.7 U3 / 7.0 U1+, Citrix Hypervisor 8.2+

notes: CPU support depends on board revision: rev 1.x supports EPYC 7001/7002; EPYC 7003 (Zen 3) requires rev 3.x or later. Check the revision sticker before selling with Milan CPUs.
E-ATX (305 × 330 mm) – needs a case that supports E-ATX / SSI-EEB.

zh.shortDescription: SP3 双路服务器主板：支持 2 颗 EPYC、16 条内存插槽、5 个 SlimSAS 接口并内置 IPMI 管理。
zh.description: 技嘉 MZ71-CE1 可同时运行两颗 AMD EPYC 处理器，单板最多 128 核。16 条 DDR4 插槽 (每 CPU 八通道)、最多 5 条 PCIe x16、5 个 SlimSAS 接口可接 SATA 或 NVMe 硬盘，并配备带独立管理网口的 ASPEED AST2500 BMC，是渲染农场、虚拟化集群和存储服务器的可靠平台。
highlights: 16 条 DDR4，每 CPU 八通道

specs.内存插槽: 16 条 DDR4 (每 CPU 八通道)，RDIMM/LRDIMM 最高 3200 MHz，单条最大 128 GB
specs.扩展插槽: 最多 5 条 PCIe x16 (Gen3；搭配 EPYC 7002 时其中一条为 Gen4)
specs.SATA / SAS 接口: 4 × SATA 6Gb/s + 5 × SlimSAS (最多 12 × SATA 和 5 × NVMe Gen3 x4)
specs.网卡: 2 × 千兆网口 (Broadcom BCM5720) + 1 个独立管理网口
specs.后置 I/O: 2 × USB 3.0, 1 × VGA, 1 × COM, 2 × RJ45, 1 × MLAN, ID button

specs.风扇接口: 2 个 CPU 风扇接口，4 个系统风扇接口
specs.兼容操作系统: Windows Server 2016/2019, RHEL 8.3+, SLES 12 SP5 / 15 SP2+, Ubuntu 18.04.5 / 20.04+, VMware ESXi 6.7 U3 / 7.0 U1+, Citrix Hypervisor 8.2+
